item.title: Service research in the digital era
item.content:encoded:
Digital transformation is reshaping how services are conceptualized and delivered across business and society. Technological advances including artificial intelligence, augmented reality, the internet of Things, and blockchain are fundamentally changing value co-creation dynamics between human and non-human actors, requiring service research to evolve and adapt to these new realities.

Markets can be understood as service ecosystems where diverse actors collaborate to create value through various institutional arrangements. Technological adoption generates both opportunities and challenges that stimulate market emergence, transformation, and the development of new service platforms, creating rich possibilities for research across multiple dimensions.

This collection welcomes original research exploring how digital technologies enable and shape service systems, market dynamics, and value co-creation. The journal invites conceptual, qualitative, and quantitative contributions, including case studies and position papers that examine service research within the digital era across diverse industry contexts.

Potential topics

  • Service research and digital transformation
  • Human-machine interactions and robots in value co-creation
  • Technologies as enablers of market emergence and transformation
  • Technologies and market shaping and market viability
  • Phygital customer journey and metaverses
  • Service research in complex industry settings
  • Business models to manage networks and service systems
  • Emergence and institutionalization in service ecosystems
  • Application of service-dominant logic to networks and markets
  • Advances in combining network theory and service science
